passages: A personal Google Account or a work or school Google Account with access to Gemini turned on by your administrator.
At least 200 MB of available disk space for installation.
For quick access to Gemini, you can use the keyboard shortcut Alt + Space.
Analyze images: Upload images and ask Gemini questions about their content.

records.authority: Google Workspace primary update for availability and administration in managed accounts.
passages: The Alt + Space keyboard shortcut brings Gemini over active work for quick tasks, like fact-checking a document or brainstorming presentation titles.
Users can ask Gemini to draft project summaries using information pulled directly from Google Workspace apps like Gmail and Google Drive.
Available to all Google Workspace customers, Workspace Individual subscribers, and users with personal Google accounts
records.limitation: The update describes Google’s product scope; organisation policy and account access remain account-specific.

records.authority: Google release notes for the Windows app release and described desktop connections.
passages: You can get quick answers, draft messages and brainstorm ideas right alongside your active applications.
The Gemini app is now available on Windows. Press Alt + Space to summon Gemini instantly from anywhere on your PC whenever you need it.
You can connect to Google apps like Gmail and Google Drive to summarise documents and find information quickly, generate custom images with Nano Banana and dive into in-depth research on any topic.
The app is available on Windows 10 or later.
records.limitation: Release notes describe stated features; they do not establish automatic access to a screen, files or every connected service.
